title: Kung Fu Boy (Kotaro Makaritoru) Vol 49 Chinese Manga - Tong Li
categoryName: Collectibles:Comic Books & Memorabilia:Manga & Asian Comics:Single Volumes
descriptionText:
Condition: Very Good – mild yellowing due to age, minimal shelf wear, no tears or markings. Spine is tight and clean. Pages are intact and crisp (see photos).
Language: Traditional Chinese
Publisher: 東立出版社 (Tong Li Publishing Co., Ltd.)
Series: 正式授權中文版 少年系列 (Official Licensed Chinese Shōnen Edition)
ISBN: 957-34-0205-X
Price on cover: NT$75 / HK$28
Description
This is Volume 49 of the long-running martial arts comedy manga 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy) by Tatsuya Egawa (蛭田達也), officially licensed and published in Taiwan by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社).
In this later volume, the series’ trademark mix of humor, martial arts action, and school-life antics continues in full form. This official Tong Li edition is part of the nostalgic 90s print run and includes the author’s note section (“著者近影”) featuring a photo of Egawa with his cats — a fun collectible detail for fans.
